One-week event (each game takes 2–15 min, with cooldowns from 15 min to 20 h)

Orcsoberfest is a seasonal event on {wiki:Orcsoberfest Island|Orcsoberfest Island}, where the brutish {creature:Orger|Orgers} organise "games" that are just excuses to eat and drink. You take part in fishing, hammers, races, sausage contests and King Chuck's banquet to earn {wiki:Festive Point|Festive Points}, which you trade with {npc:Xaver} for rewards. Each edition you take part in also gives you a piece of the Traditional Set and, every two, a part of the Orcsoberfest Garb outfit.
Tent south of Thais (trip to Orcsoberfest Island)
Teleport in the tent south of Thais

When the pig gets fat, it turns into the {creature:Fat Porker}, a creature with lots of health but harmless. Kill it. Whoever wants to win must have fed the pig **and** attacked the creature. Points depend on how much food you gave.

In the Feeding Grounds, go down to the **second floor** and look for the teleport on the **west** side of the cave. 1 to 5 players can enter (at least 3 recommended). You can do the Feast **once per hour, up to 3 times in 20 hours** (the 20 hours count from the last attempt of the day). You have **10 minutes** for all phases.

The {wiki:Orc Cook|Orc Cook}, southwest of the room, shouts which ingredient (or firewood) the king wants in the cauldron in the centre. The ingredients are on 4 tables, one on each side of the room. Use the right table to pick up the ingredient and use it in the cauldron straight away. If you fail in time, the team loses time.
Where each ingredient is on the tables
Using the right ingredient on the cauldron
Put one player in charge of each table. The ingredients are not normal items: you can't bring them from outside.

After 5 ingredients in the cauldron, 4 {creature:Rampaging Beer Elemental|Rampaging Beer Elementals} appear. Lure them onto the traps on the floor: they become {creature:Captured Beer}. The Captured Beers run away from you: push them (by walking behind them) to the other barrels in the **northwest** of the room.
The Rampaging Beer Elementals in the Feast room
Don't let the Beer Elementals hit you: every 3 hits you lose 1 minute of the maximum time.

After you have done the first two phases twice, {wiki:King Chuck|King Chuck} gets up from the table as {creature:Angry King Chuck}. Use the barrel near the Orc Cook (southwest): a barrel of {wiki:Strong Orger Beer|Strong Orger Beer} appears near the cauldron. Lure the king to the barrel so he drinks. After **5 barrels** he calms down and goes back to the table.
Use the barrel near the Orc Cook
Lure King Chuck to the Orger Beer
Don't let Angry King Chuck hit you: after a few hits (about 3) you are kicked out of the room.

After you have calmed the king twice, an {wiki:Orger Treasure|Orger Treasure} appears **south** of the cauldron. It has lots of health but doesn't attack. Destroy it with everything you have (the remaining time may be short) to get the loot.
100 Festive Points and a small chance of an Orcsoberfest plushie
Exchange the {wiki:Festive Point|Festive Points} with {npc:Xaver} on the island for various rewards. Win all the games at least once to get the **Orcsoberfest Welcome** achievement.

In each edition of the event in which you defeat {wiki:King Chuck|King Chuck} you receive a piece of the {wiki:Traditional Set|Traditional Set}; every two participations you also receive a part of the outfit. At least 6 editions (3 years) are needed for the full outfit.
On the weekend after the event (from Friday's server save to Monday's server save), all worlds receive **50% extra XP** against creatures of the Demon class in the Bestiary.
The event repeats twice a year (October and March); pieces and addons carry over between editions.
Approximate fishing rates: 33% with the Simple Fishing Rod, 10% with the Advanced Fishing Rod.
